syllabus_metadata.title: Mathematics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education
syllabus_metadata.subject: Mathematics

competences.specific_competence: 1.1 Use rates and variations in different contexts

learning_activities.activity: (a) Describe the concepts of rates and variations
teaching_learning_methods: Exploration: Organise students in manageable groups and guide them to explore real-life problems related to the concepts of rates and variations
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Concepts of rates and variations are well described
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Mathematical sets, marker pens, calculators, charts of real life scenarios, graph papers, rates and variation animations

learning_activities.activity: (b) Solve problems on rates and variations
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: In manageable groups, guide students to solve problems involving rates and variations
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Problems on rates and variations are correctly solved
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Mathematical sets, marker pens, calculators, charts of real life scenarios, graph papers

competences.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts in geometry and algebra
competences.specific_competence: 2.1 Use geometry, approximations, relations and functions in various contexts

learning_activities.activity: (a) Describe the concepts of geometry (similarities and congruence)
teaching_learning_methods: Exploration: Guide the students to explore shapes and identify congruent and similar figures through direct comparison

Group discussion: In manageable groups, guide students to discuss the concepts of similarities and congruences through hands-on activities that involve physical manipulatives, such as pattern blocks, tangrams or geoboards
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Concepts of geometry are well described
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Mathematical sets, marker pens, calculators, graph papers, geometrical figures animations, congruence and similarities simulations

learning_activities.activity: (b) Recognize properties of similar triangles
teaching_learning_methods: Visual representation: Guide students to use pictures, charts, diagrams, and models to recognize properties of similar triangles
Jigsaw: Guide students to constructs and manipulate similar and congruent triangles and associate them to real-life applications
Exploration: Guide students to connect similar triangles to real world applications
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Properties of similar triangles are clearly recognized
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Mathematical sets, marker pens, calculators, graph papers

learning_activities.activity: (c) Explain postulates, proofs, and theorems of congruent triangles
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Guide students to discuss postulates, proofs, and theorems of congruent triangles
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Postulates, proofs, and theorems of congruent triangles are clearly explained
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Mathematical sets, marker pens, calculators, graph papers

competences.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts in geometry and algebra
competences.specific_competence: 2.2 Use algebra and matrices in problem solving

learning_activities.activity: (a) Explore the basic tenets of algebra (binary operations, quadratic expressions and equations, radicals, exponents, and logarithms)
teaching_learning_methods: Jigsaw: Organise students in manageable groups to discuss the concepts of algebra (binary operations, quadratic expressions and equations, radicals, exponents, and logarithms)
Graphical methods: Organize students in manageable groups and guide them to use graphs to solve quadratic equations
Use of technology: Guide students to use technology such as Excel, GeoGebra, Microsoft Mathematics, and MATLAB to solve quadratic equations
Problems solving: In manageable groups, guide students to apply binary operations to simplify quadratic expressions
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of algebra are explored correctly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Mathematical sets, marker pens, calculators, Mathematical software such as GeoGebra, MATLAB, Maple, Mathematica, graphing calculators

learning_activities.activity: (b) Solve quadratic equations by using different methods (factorisation, Completing the square, and quadratic formula)
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Guide students through solving quadratic equations by using factorisation, completing the square, and quadratic formula
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Quadratic equations are solved correctly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Mathematical sets, marker pens, calculators

learning_activities.activity: (c) Identify and use laws of exponents involving positive, negative, and zero exponents (multiplication law, division law, power law, and zero index)
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: In manageable groups, guide students to identify and discuss multiplication law, division law, power law, and zero index
Problem solving: Guide students to discuss and use laws of exponents involving positive, negative, and zero exponents to simplify and solve exponential equations
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Laws of exponents are identified and used correctly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Exponent games and applications, exponent puzzles, exponent rule posters, visual aids, exponent animations

learning_activities.activity: (d) Write numbers in standard form
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: In manageable groups, guide students to discuss and write numbers in standard form
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Numbers are correctly written in standard form
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Calculators, number charts

learning_activities.activity: (e) Use laws of logarithms to solve problems
teaching_learning_methods: Interactive discussion: Guide students to discuss and use laws of logarithms to solve problems involving logarithms
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Laws of logarithms are used to solve problems correctly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Calculators

learning_activities.activity: (f) Perform operations on radicals and rationalize the denominators
teaching_learning_methods: Problem solving: Guide students to discuss and perform operations on radicals and rationalize the denominators
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Operations on radicals and denominators are clearly performed
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Calculators

competences.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts in geometry and algebra
competences.specific_competence: 2.3 Use sets, sequences and series in problem solving

learning_activities.activity: (a) Explore the basic tenets of sets (types of sets, subsets, operation with sets, and Venn diagrams of two sets)
teaching_learning_methods: Exploration: Organise students in manageable groups to explore the concepts of sets, subsets, operations of sets, and Venn diagram of two sets
Jigsaw: Organise students in manageable groups to illustrate concepts of sets, subsets, operations of sets, and Venn diagrams of two sets using real-life examples
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of sets are clearly explored
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Real objects, set simulations, charts of different sets, playing cards, coloured chalks

learning_activities.activity: (b) Distinguish among different types of sets (universal set, equal sets, empty/null set, finite and infinite sets, equivalent sets, and disjoint sets)
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Organise students in manageable groups to discuss the different types of sets
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Different types of sets are clearly distinguished
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Real objects, charts of different sets

learning_activities.activity: (c) Compare sets (subsets and universal sets)
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Organise students in manageable groups to compare subsets and universal sets
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Sets are clearly compared
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Real objects, set simulations

learning_activities.activity: (d) Perform operations with sets (union, intersection, and complement of a set)
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Organise students in manageable groups to perform operations with sets
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Operations with sets are correctly performed
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Charts of different sets

learning_activities.activity: (e) Represent two sets in a Venn diagram
teaching_learning_methods: Visual representation: Guide students to use charts and tables to represent two sets in a Venn diagram
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Sets in a Venn diagram are correctly represented
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Coloured chalks

learning_activities.activity: (f) Find the number of elements in a set
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Organise students in manageable groups to discuss and determine the number of elements in a set
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Number of elements in a set are correctly found
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Real objects

competences.main_competence: 3.0 Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts in coordinate geometry, trigonometry, circles, vectors, probability and statistics
competences.specific_competence: 3.1 Use basic coordinate geometry, trigonometry and vectors skills in daily life

learning_activities.activity: (a) Explore the basic tenets of trigonometry (trigonometric ratios, angles of elevation and depression)
teaching_learning_methods: Exploration: Organise students in manageable groups to explore the concepts of trigonometric ratios, angles of elevation and depression using real-life examples
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The basic tenets of trigonometry are clearly explored
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Geometry animations, Mathematical software such as GeoGebra, MATLAB, Maple, Mathematica, graph paper, mathematical set

learning_activities.activity: (b) Determine trigonometric ratios of angles and special angles
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: In manageable groups, guide students to discuss and determine trigonometric ratios of angles and special angles
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Trigonometric ratios of angles and special angles are clearly determined
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Mathematical set

learning_activities.activity: (c) Calculate angles of elevation and depression
teaching_learning_methods: Jigsaw: Organise students in manageable groups to discuss and calculate angles of elevation and depression
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Angles of elevation and depression are calculated correctly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Mathematical set
